plaatsen.tekst: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,
I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth
If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die
Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge
And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer
